title: Business Security Deposit Recalculation
content:
Held business Security Deposits are subject to recalculation; residential deposits are never recalculated.

## Clauses in force

1. **Lower recalculated amount.** When the recalculated amount is lower than the held cash and the kind refunds excess, the held cash above the new amount is refunded as an excess refund and the deposit stays held.
2. **Residential kinds.** Residential deposits are never recalculated.

## Clauses no longer in force

- Business deposits are recalculated at the kind's recalculation interval after the fully secured date with the same formula as at assessment. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)
- When the recalculated amount exceeds the held cash by more than the kind's increase threshold of the held cash, the deposit returns to assessed with the new required amount and the difference due within the kind's additional-deposit period. (no longer in force; superseded by the current basis)

## Hypothetical illustration of an excess refund

A Medium Commercial Service Deposit holds USD 6000.00 in cash and its recalculated amount is USD 5200.00. The kind refunds excess, so USD 800.00 is refunded as an excess refund and the deposit stays held with USD 5200.00 in cash.

## Basis questions

**Is a Residential New Service Deposit recalculated after a year of higher bills?**
No. Residential deposits are never recalculated.

**Does an excess refund change the deposit's status?**
No. The deposit stays held.

superseded_clauses: Business deposits are recalculated every recalculation_frequency_months after the fully secured date with the same formula as at assessment.

When the recalculated amount exceeds the held cash by more than recalculation_increase_threshold_pct of the held cash, the deposit returns to assessed with the new required amount and the difference due within additional_deposit_due_days.
